notes: Pilot measurements on in-process Hardhat automining; not public chain throughput or consensus finality.
payloadKiB is bytes per task. batchSize is a client scheduling group, NOT contract aggregation.
Matrix tasks store dataHash only. DA payload is not onchain in the matrix.
Separate calldata test publishes all batchSize*payloadKiB bytes through a contract hashing the bytes.
Recovery uses EVM time jumps, not real waiting. P95 with five samples is descriptive, not a reliable tail estimate.
No measured real blob fee; do not infer blob savings from calldata alone.
